title: Zesty Roasted Thai Beef Larb
description: A romantic Thai dish featuring hot beef stock, sashimi-cut beef, and a low-glycemic twist. This larb recipe is perfect for a special dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, Thai red chili peppers, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, ginger, cilantro, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
When ready to cook, heat the coconut oil in a large cazuela over medium-high heat. Add the beef mixture and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through.
Transfer the cazuela to the preheated oven and roast for 12-15 minutes, or until the meat is caramelized and crispy.

Remove the cazuela from the oven and carefully pour in the hot beef stock. Return the cazuela to the oven and roast for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the meat is coated in a sticky glaze.
Remove the cazuela from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the zesty roasted Thai beef larb hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve with steamed vegetables or sticky rice, if desired.
